api.1: Ranting kering kutumpuk di tengah tanah lapang.
api.2: Api kecil menyala. Malam ini ladang tidak gelap sendirian.

pita.1: Pita merah tersangkut di tiang pondok.
pita.2: Ini pita Joy. Ia tidak pernah melepasnya.
pita.3: Aku ikat pita itu di pergelanganku. Aku bersumpah: aku yang menemukan dia.

jejak.1: Jejak kaki telanjang di tanah basah. Kecil, bukan sepatu.
jejak.2: Berputar di sekitar pondok, lalu hilang ke arah hutan.

tungku.1: Tungku pondok sudah dingin. Abu menumpuk berhari-hari.
tungku.2: Joy tidak memasak di sini sudah lama.

langit.1: Langit timur mulai pucat. Pagi hampir tiba.
langit.2: Aku begadang semalam dan tidak terjadi apa-apa. Itu kabar baik.

pulang.1: Api kupadamkan. Pita tetap di pergelanganku.
pulang.2: Aku pulang ke desa sebelum warga bangun.

b10alt.jaga: Stand watch at the field until morning

api.1: I pile dry twigs in the middle of the clearing.
api.2: A small fire catches. Tonight the field is not dark alone.

pita.1: A red ribbon snagged on the hut pole.
pita.2: This is Joy's ribbon. She never took it off.
pita.3: I tie the ribbon around my wrist. I swear: I will be the one who finds her.

jejak.1: Bare footprints in the wet soil. Small, no shoes.
jejak.2: They circle the hut, then vanish toward the forest.

tungku.1: The hut stove is cold. Ash piled up for days.
tungku.2: Joy has not cooked here for a long time.

langit.1: The eastern sky turns pale. Morning is near.
langit.2: I stayed up all night and nothing happened. That is good news.

pulang.1: I put out the fire. The ribbon stays on my wrist.
pulang.2: I walk home to the village before anyone wakes.
